title: Shifted integration by parts: integral of <zeta(x) - zeta(x - de), g(x)> equals d times integral of <segment average of g, D_e zeta>
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U an open subset of R^n, g : R^n -> R^l continuous on U, zeta : R^n -> R^l of class C^1 with compact support, e in R^n and d in R, such that x + (td)e lies in U for every x in tsupport zeta and every t in [0,1]. Then the integral over R^n of <zeta(x) - zeta(x - de), g(x)> dx equals d times the integral over R^n of < integral_0^1 g(x + (td)e) dt , Dzeta(x)e > dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (g ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (e : Rn n) (d : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContinuousOn g U → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ x ∈ tsupport ζ, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, x + (t * d) • e ∈ U) → ∫ x, inner ℝ (ζ x - ζ (x - d • e)) (g x) = d * ∫ x, inner ℝ (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (x + (t * d) • e)) (fderiv ℝ ζ x e)
